The complete Purchase course. Approvals, orders, bills and contractor RA bills.
Management approves.
When the site asks for material, Sameer gets an email with a button. It opens this page, on the phone, without signing in.
It shows what is asked for, for which floor, the approximate value, and whether it is within that floor’s BOQ budget.
One tap approves it. To reject, tap Reject and write the reason: the site sees it.
Everything is also on the Purchase page, where Management can approve from the list. A request waiting more than a day goes up to Rafi Sir.
Purchase places the order.
The purchase team opens Purchase. Waiting for me lists the approved requests to order.
Open the request. Enter the vendor, the quantity and the rate including GST, and the bill details. The ERP checks the rate against the budget rate.
Save the order. The site now sees it under Deliveries expected, without any rates or amounts. Site logins never see money.
When the site receives a delivery, the request shows what came, the challan number, and the photo of the challan.
Accounts approves the bill.
Accounts checks the bill against what the site received. If less came, the amount payable is worked out for the quantity received.
Approve it for payment. It then shows in Payments Out, so the payment fills in by itself, and the request is marked Paid.
Contractor RA bills.
Contractor bills are on their own page: tap Contractor bills on the Purchase page. Each contractor has a work order with the item rates.
The work order has the items and rates, retention, TDS, the advance and how fast it is recovered, and the wastage allowed on our RMC and steel.
For a new RA bill, the slab work done since the last bill is filled in from the slabs site marked cast.
It shows previous, this bill and cumulative for each item. Anything beyond the work order quantity is marked in red.
Recovery for RMC and steel used beyond the design quantity plus the allowance is suggested from the site’s records.
Retention, TDS and advance recovery are worked out, and the net payable is at the bottom. Save and submit it to Management.
Approve and pay the RA bill.
Sameer opens the bill, checks the quantities and deductions, and approves the net amount. The person who entered a bill can never approve it.
Accounts then pays it and records the UTR. Approved bills to pay are in the 10 am summary under cash needed.
That is the end of this course. You can watch any part again from the Training videos page.
